intro: An iron shield, blackened by fire, is fixed to the crumbling chimney of the burned Shady Rest Inn. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore is waiting on evidence from the inn's site.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.
The shield can be removed from the brick of the chimney.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found evidence from the site of the Shady Rest Inn?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm, I'm no expert with the construction of arms and armor. Their use, yes, but not their making.
This shield seems as ordinary as any, excepting the damage from the fire that engulfed the inn.
